quote: Keep the layered split intact: protocol-agnostic engine, adapters, surfaces.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, modules must preserve the engine / adapters / surfaces layering (no reverse imports from engine/core into adapters or surfaces).

quote: Durable runtime state lives under `.codex-autorunner/`.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code must persist durable runtime state under the `.codex-autorunner/` root rather than elsewhere.

quote: Prefer deterministic behavior, explicit config, small diffs, and observable failures.
statement: In all code, changes should prefer deterministic behavior, explicit config and observable failures.

quote: Update tickets only under `.codex-autorunner/tickets/`. Update context docs only under `.codex-autorunner/contextspace/`. Do not create duplicate ticket or context files elsewhere in the repo.
statement: In the repo, ticket files must live only under .codex-autorunner/tickets/ and context docs only under .codex-autorunner/contextspace/; duplicates elsewhere must not be created.

quote: Frontend JS: edit `src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/src/`; use `make serve` for Vite HMR against the local hub, or `pnpm run build` / `make build` to refresh `web_static/`.
statement: In the web UI, frontend source changes must be made in src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/src/, not by hand-editing the built src/codex_autorunner/web_static/ output.

quote: Always read `src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/DESIGN.md` before making any visual or UI decisions. All font choices, colors, spacing, border radii, and aesthetic direction are defined there. Do not deviate without explicit user approval.
statement: In UI code, fonts, colors, spacing, border radii and aesthetics must follow src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/DESIGN.md.

quote: Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
statement: In the project, changes should not add unnecessary third-party dependencies.

quote: All tests must use isolated temp directories via fixtures (`tmp_path`) rather than writing to shared `/tmp` paths. A guard (`scripts/check_test_tmp_usage.py`) enforces this automatically during `check.sh` and CI.
statement: In tests/**, tests must use the pytest tmp_path fixture for temp directories and must not write to shared absolute /tmp paths.

quote: Include tests when behavior changes.
statement: In the project, behavior changes must be accompanied by tests.

quote: Behavior-changing defaults must be explicit and discoverable.
statement: In config code, behavior-changing defaults must be explicit and discoverable.

quote: Prefer file-backed config over env-only hidden state.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, configuration should be file-backed rather than read only from environment variables.

quote: Generated outputs must be reproducible and clearly marked. Avoid hand-editing generated files; change generators instead.
statement: In the repo, generated files must be clearly marked and should not be hand-edited; change the generator instead.

quote: No silent fallbacks.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code must not silently fall back on failure; fallbacks must be observable (logged/reported).

quote: Errors must be attributable to a run and leave evidence.
statement: In run execution code, errors must be attributable to a run_id and leave evidence artifacts.

quote: Timeouts and partial outputs are first-class outcomes.
statement: In run execution code, timeouts and partial outputs must be represented as explicit outcomes rather than ignored.

quote: Shared PMA/Discord/Telegram chat behavior belongs here or in `core/orchestration/`; do not rebuild transcript ordering, queued-turn state, progress semantics, final-delivery policy, or delivery retry state inside a surface adapter.
statement: In Discord/Telegram surface adapters, code must not implement transcript ordering, queued-turn state, progress semantics, final-delivery policy or delivery retry state; that belongs in adapters/chat/ or core/orchestration/.

quote: Keep command identity and workspace semantics in shared command modules (`command_contract.py`, `command_kernel.py`), not in Discord or Telegram transport files.
statement: In chat adapters, command identity and workspace semantics must live in adapters/chat/command_contract.py and command_kernel.py, not in Discord or Telegram transport modules.

quote: Keep managed-thread coordinator setup, durable final-delivery hooks, and bound queue-progress wiring in shared chat modules when the behavior is intentionally surface-parity.
statement: In chat adapters, managed-thread coordinator setup, durable final-delivery hooks and queue-progress wiring must live in shared adapters/chat/ modules, not per-surface.

quote: Discord and Telegram modules should own only transport adapters: ingress payload parsing, platform IDs, message formatting, and API delivery calls.
statement: In adapters/discord/ and adapters/telegram/, modules should contain only transport concerns: ingress payload parsing, platform IDs, message formatting and API delivery calls.

quote: When extracting behavior from a surface file, prefer adding a reusable shared helper here only if both surfaces can consume the same contract without platform conditionals leaking back in.
statement: In adapters/chat/, shared helpers should not contain platform-specific (Discord vs Telegram) conditionals.

quote: Do not reintroduce legacy notification-terminal heuristics into `client.py` without a concrete supported runtime and dedicated coverage.
statement: In agents/acp/client.py, code must not reintroduce legacy notification-based turn-terminal heuristics.

quote: For official ACP, CAR must not invent completion from plain progress or assistant text alone.
statement: In agents/acp/, turn completion must not be inferred from progress notifications or assistant text alone; it requires explicit terminal notifications or the session/prompt RPC response.

quote: `session/update` is progress, not terminal completion.
statement: In agents/acp/, `session/update` notifications must be treated as progress and must not close a turn.

quote: `null` should be treated as a missing-session failure.
statement: In agents/acp/, a null `session/load` response must be treated as a missing-session failure.

quote: `{}` or other object responses without a session identifier should still be accepted when the caller already knows the requested `session_id`.
statement: In agents/acp/, `session/load` object responses lacking a session identifier should be accepted when the caller already knows the session_id.

quote: Do not require `sessionId` in official `session/load` success payloads unless the protocol itself changes and the code/tests are updated together.
statement: In agents/acp/, parsing of official `session/load` success payloads must not require a `sessionId` field.

quote: `session/update`, `session/request_permission`, and explicit terminal lifecycle events are rebound to the active local turn when they omit `turnId`.
statement: In agents/acp/, session/update, session/request_permission and terminal lifecycle events lacking `turnId` must be rebound to the active local turn.

quote: Busy `session.status` notifications must not be treated as terminal.
statement: In agents/acp/, busy `session.status` notifications must not be treated as turn-terminal.

quote: Do not broaden this fallback set unless the protocol requires it and the tests prove the need.
statement: In agents/acp/, the set of events rebound to the active turn when `turnId` is missing must not be broadened without protocol need and tests.

quote: | `client.py` | Transport, request/response tracking, official session protocol, prompt state | | `events.py` | Notification normalization into CAR event types | | `protocol.py` | Coercion/parsing of ACP initialize/session/prompt payloads |
statement: In agents/acp/, transport and request tracking belong in client.py, notification normalization in events.py, payload coercion/parsing in protocol.py, client lifecycle in supervisor.py and ACP errors in errors.py.

quote: At minimum, update or add focused tests in: - `tests/agents/acp/test_client.py` Use `tests/fixtures/fake_acp_server.py` to model protocol behavior directly.
statement: In tests for ACP behavior changes, tests must be added in tests/agents/acp/test_client.py and should model protocol behavior with tests/fixtures/fake_acp_server.py.

quote: Add a fixture scenario for any non-default behavior before wiring the agent into Discord/Telegram/PMA surfaces.
statement: In ACP agent integrations, any non-default protocol behavior must have a fake ACP server fixture scenario before the agent is wired into surfaces.

quote: Route handlers live under `routes/`; prefer extending the closest route package before growing `app.py`.
statement: In surfaces/web/, FastAPI route handlers must live under surfaces/web/routes/ and should extend an existing route package rather than being added to app.py.

quote: Shared web-specific logic belongs in `services/`, `static_assets.py`, `static_refresh.py`, or nearby helpers.
statement: In surfaces/web/, shared web-specific logic must live in services/, static_assets.py, static_refresh.py or nearby helpers, not in route modules.

quote: Web Hub UI: `../../web_frontend/` → ignored package artifact `../../web_static/`. Do not require generated static assets in normal PRs; release/package builds produce and verify them.
statement: In the repo, generated web_static/ assets must not be required or committed in normal changes.

quote: The Web Chat primary rendering contract is `/hub/pma/threads/{id}/transcript` and `/transcript/events`; `/tail` and `/timeline` are diagnostics/projection inputs. Do not add web-local transcript composition or delivery state machines.
statement: In surfaces/web/, PMA chat routes must expose the backend transcript projection from adapters/chat/ and core/orchestration/ and must not add web-local transcript composition or delivery state machines.

quote: Web UI screen routes should expose screen-shaped read models with cursors and repair policies. Keep contracts in `read_model_contracts.py`, route assembly under `routes/`, and projection/rebuild logic in `core/` near the canonical data source.
statement: In the web surface, read-model contracts must live in surfaces/web/read_model_contracts.py, route assembly under surfaces/web/routes/, and projection/rebuild logic in core/ near the canonical data source.

quote: Do not add new broad list endpoints or normal polling endpoints as primary UI data sources when a scoped read model would fit. Existing broad endpoints must remain diagnostics/tests-only or have a documented migration exception.
statement: In surfaces/web/routes/, new broad list or polling endpoints must not be added as primary UI data sources; use scoped read models.

quote: Every stream event must be typed, ordered within its source, idempotent, and repairable from a snapshot route. Cursor gaps must be explicit.
statement: In surfaces/web/ streaming routes, every stream event must be typed, ordered within its source, idempotent and repairable from a snapshot route, and cursor gaps must be emitted explicitly.

quote: For a new high-cardinality read model, add route coverage for bounded windows and extend the web responsiveness budget smoke where appropriate.
statement: In tests, a new high-cardinality read model should have route tests for bounded windows and extend the web responsiveness budget smoke.

quote: `app.py`'s `_register_spa_shell_routes` reads that manifest at app construction and registers a shell-serving route per template. **Adding, removing, or renaming a `+page.svelte` route requires no `app.py` change** — just rebuild.
statement: In surfaces/web/app.py, SPA shell routes must be registered from the generated web_static/spa_routes.json manifest, not a hand-maintained route list (only _NEST_TOLERANT_SPA_SEGMENTS and worktrees handlers stay hand-maintained).

quote: If the manifest is missing or unreadable (partial/old build), app construction does not crash — it logs a warning and falls back to broad shell coverage for `repos/`, `tickets/`, `contextspace/`
statement: In surfaces/web/app.py, a missing or unreadable SPA route manifest must not crash app construction; it must log a warning and fall back to broad shell coverage.

quote: It builds into the ignored `../web_static/` package-artifact directory. Normal PRs should commit source, tests, and docs only; release/package builds produce and verify the static bundle.
statement: In the web frontend, changes should commit only source, tests and docs, not the built web_static/ bundle.

quote: If you add routes under `src/routes/` that users can refresh or open in a new tab, the FastAPI hub must serve that same HTML for those paths ... Prefer documenting a new deep path in `tests/surfaces/web/test_web_static_routes.py`.
statement: In the web frontend, new refreshable routes under src/routes/ must be served the SPA shell by the hub and should be documented in tests/surfaces/web/test_web_static_routes.py.

quote: Frontend helpers may map transcript rows to cards and keep temporary optimistic user rows until the backend confirms them, but must not compose `/turns`, `/tail`, or `/timeline` into a parallel transcript or own final-delivery state.
statement: In the web frontend PMA chat, code must render the backend transcript projection (/hub/pma/threads/{id}/transcript, /transcript/events) and must not compose /turns, /tail or /timeline into a parallel transcript or own final-delivery state.

quote: Screen data should come from Web Hub read models, not broad page-local choreography. For chats, repo/worktree, ticket, run, and artifact surfaces, prefer `src/lib/data/readModelClients.ts`, `readModelStream.ts`, `readModelStore.ts`, and selectors in `readModelViewModels.ts`.
statement: In web frontend screens for chats, repo/worktree, tickets, runs and artifacts, data should be loaded via src/lib/data/readModelClients.ts, readModelStream.ts, readModelStore.ts and readModelViewModels.ts selectors.

quote: Route loaders: keep testable helpers in `src/lib/routes/` (or another non-`+page.ts` module).
statement: In the web frontend, testable route-loader helpers must live in src/lib/routes/ (or another non-+page.ts module), not in +page.ts.

quote: SvelteKit `+page.ts` / `+page.server.ts` may export only `load`, `prerender`, `csr`, `ssr`, `trailingSlash`, `config`, `entries`, or `_`-prefixed symbols. Type-only exports are fine.
statement: In SvelteKit +page.ts / +page.server.ts files, value exports must be limited to load, prerender, csr, ssr, trailingSlash, config, entries or _-prefixed symbols (type-only exports allowed).

quote: Route load tests should import helpers through `src/lib/test/importRouteLoader.ts` instead of re-implementing the browser environment mock in every file.
statement: In web frontend route load tests, helpers should be imported via src/lib/test/importRouteLoader.ts instead of re-implementing the browser environment mock.

quote: Normal updates should arrive through cursor streams plus repair snapshots. Do not add recurring `setInterval`/quiet-refresh loops for migrated screens.
statement: In web frontend migrated screens, code must not add recurring setInterval / quiet-refresh polling loops; updates come through cursor streams and repair snapshots.

quote: Read-model-backed pages should render stale cached data while refreshing. Add a non-blocking `+page.ts` loader (`ensureXLoaded({ blocking: false })`), store snapshots in `readModelEntityStore`, and select from the store in the Svelte page.
statement: In read-model-backed SvelteKit routes, +page.ts must call an ensureXLoaded({ blocking: false }) loader, store snapshots in readModelEntityStore, and the +page.svelte must select from the store.

quote: Do not fetch read-model snapshots directly from `+page.svelte` and blank back to skeletons on every navigation; `readModelRouteConventions.test.ts` enforces this for route pages.
statement: In SvelteKit +page.svelte files, code must not fetch read-model snapshots directly (e.g. readModels.*(), /hub/read-models/ URLs, getServicesReadModel()).

quote: High-cardinality UI must stay windowed and virtualized. Do not render unbounded chat, timeline, repo/worktree, ticket, artifact, or dispatch lists with raw `{#each}` loops.
statement: In Svelte components, unbounded chat, timeline, repo/worktree, ticket, artifact or dispatch lists must be windowed/virtualized and must not be rendered with raw {#each} loops.

quote: Legacy broad client methods are diagnostics/tests-only unless a durable doc explicitly says otherwise. A new screen shape needs a backend projection, typed event/contract, selector, and scale test.
statement: In the web frontend, screens must not use legacy broad client methods; a new screen shape must have a backend projection, typed event/contract, selector and scale test.

quote: `src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/src/**/*.test.ts`: default Svelte Web Hub tests
statement: In the web frontend, Svelte Web Hub unit tests should be colocated as src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/src/**/*.test.ts; FastAPI web route tests go in tests/surfaces/web/.

quote: Engine importing Control Plane, Adapters, or Surfaces
statement: In Engine modules (codex_autorunner.core.flows*, codex_autorunner.core.ports*), code must import only stdlib and external packages, not Control Plane, Adapters or Surfaces modules.

quote: Control Plane importing Adapters or Surfaces
statement: In Control Plane modules (codex_autorunner.core* excluding flows/ports, codex_autorunner.contextspace*, codex_autorunner.tickets*), code must not import codex_autorunner.adapters*, agents*, flows* or surfaces*.

quote: Adapters importing Surfaces
statement: In Adapter modules (codex_autorunner.adapters*, codex_autorunner.agents*, codex_autorunner.flows*), code must not import codex_autorunner.surfaces*.

quote: Avoid owning business logic; keep logic in engine/control plane
statement: In adapters, code should not own business logic; business logic belongs in the engine/control plane.

quote: Do not become state owners; never be the only place truth lives
statement: In surfaces, code must not own durable state or be the only place truth lives.

quote: No surface may call `rotate_corrupt_flow_db`. Replacing a user's durable flow database is an engine decision; surfaces route through `flows.controller_provider.recover_flow_store`, the single place that decision is made.
statement: In surfaces/**, code must not call rotate_corrupt_flow_db; it must use flows.controller_provider.recover_flow_store instead.

quote: No module under `surfaces/web/` may construct `FlowController`. HTTP handlers resolve one via `flows.controller_provider.FlowControllerProvider`, which owns construction, caching, and corrupt-store recovery.
statement: In surfaces/web/**, code must not construct FlowController directly; it must resolve one via flows.controller_provider.FlowControllerProvider.

quote: Managed-thread finalization must emit a durable delivery intent in the control plane before any user-visible final Discord or Telegram delivery begins.
statement: In managed-thread finalization code, a durable delivery intent must be recorded in the control plane before any final Discord/Telegram delivery is sent.

quote: Durable managed-thread final delivery records, claims, and replay policy live under `core/orchestration`; adapter code may execute those records but must not create a second source of truth.
statement: In Discord/Telegram adapter code, final delivery records, claims and replay policy must not be stored separately; they live under core/orchestration.

quote: Transport-local state may mirror routing or delivery context, but it must not become authoritative for durable thread identity or execution state.
statement: In transport adapters, transport-local state must not be authoritative for durable thread identity or execution state.

quote: If code is needed by multiple layers: 1. Place it in the **lowest layer** that needs it 2. If needed by Engine and above, place in Engine (e.g., `core/ports/`)
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, utilities shared across layers must be placed in the lowest layer that needs them (e.g. core/ports/ if Engine needs it).

quote: Name the file `*_shim.py` or create a `*_shim/` package 2. Add a comment header with `ARCHITECTURE_SHIM:` explaining the exception 3. Keep the shim minimal and document why it's necessary
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, any unavoidable reverse-layer import must live in a *_shim.py module or *_shim/ package whose header contains an `ARCHITECTURE_SHIM:` explanation.

quote: Avoid “shadow state” in env-only values, tmp dirs, implicit globals, or UI-only state.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code should not keep state only in environment variables, tmp dirs, implicit module globals or UI-only state.

quote: Verbose artifacts are opt-in or retention-bounded, never an unconditional per-invocation default.
statement: In run/observability code, verbose artifacts must be opt-in or retention-bounded, never written unconditionally per invocation.

quote: No hidden coupling to chat history; re-load truth from disk each run.
statement: In run execution code, state must be reloaded from disk each run rather than coupled to chat history.

quote: Owns publish notice classification, duplicate/noop suppression, and publish message construction. All message-dependent routing and suppression policy lives here; adapters and surfaces delegate to it rather than implementing ad hoc checks.
statement: In adapters and surfaces, publish notice classification and duplicate/noop suppression must delegate to core/pma_domain/ (e.g. pma_domain/publish_policy.py) rather than implementing ad hoc checks.

quote: SCM automation follows the same split: `core/scm_automation_service.py` owns routing, journaling, and retry semantics; provider adapters inject publish executors when wiring the service instead of core importing provider modules directly.
statement: In core/scm_automation_service.py, code must not import SCM provider adapter modules; provider adapters inject publish executors.

quote: `spawn_flow_worker` and `ensure_flow_worker` may apply an already-authorized start/resume/restart effect. They must not infer recovery policy from stale metadata.
statement: In spawn_flow_worker and ensure_flow_worker, code must not infer recovery policy from stale worker metadata; only apply already-authorized effects.

quote: `core/flows/worker_reaper.py` can inspect orphaned worker metadata and signal stale processes, but it never transitions runs and never claims user intent.
statement: In core/flows/worker_reaper.py, code must not transition run state or claim user intent; it only signals stale processes and writes exit evidence (exit_origin: stale_reaper).

quote: CLI, Web, Telegram, and Discord should show projection/run-state recovery fields and crash artifacts instead of inventing surface-specific crash classifications.
statement: In surfaces, code should render canonical projection/run-state recovery fields and must not invent surface-specific crash classifications.

quote: Discord, Telegram, Web, and CLI may format or deliver canonical intents, but must not derive notification dedupe keys from mutable snapshots such as `restart_attempts`, `last_recovery_action`, or adapter binding cursors like `channel_bindings.last_recovery_fingerprint`.
statement: In surfaces and chat adapters, recovery notification dedupe keys must not be derived from restart_attempts, last_recovery_action or channel_bindings.last_recovery_fingerprint; they come from the core flow notification ledger.

quote: `src/codex_autorunner/web_frontend/src/lib/data/` owns typed snapshot clients, stream cursor persistence, normalized entities, patch application, optimistic reconciliation, and selectors. Page components should subscribe to selectors and own only interaction/viewport state.
statement: In web frontend page components, data should be obtained from src/lib/data/ selectors and components should own only interaction/viewport state.

quote: High-cardinality screen surfaces must use server-side windows and frontend virtualization. Extend `tests/chat_surface_lab/web_responsiveness_budgets.py` when adding a new large read model or stream family.
statement: In high-cardinality web screens, routes must return server-side windows and the frontend must virtualize lists.

quote: Keep secrets out of logs and durable artifacts by default.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code must not write secrets to logs or durable artifacts.

quote: Centralize where secrets are loaded so audit is possible.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, secrets should be loaded through a central place rather than ad hoc.

quote: Logs are append-only and attributable to a run.
statement: In run logging code, logs must be append-only and attributable to a run.

quote: Partial output must be explicitly labeled.
statement: In run execution code, partial output must be explicitly labeled as partial.

quote: Swallowed exceptions and silent fallbacks are disallowed.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code must not swallow exceptions (e.g. bare `except: pass`) or silently fall back without logging.

quote: Discord and Telegram terminal status watchers still have a temporary `flows.db` fallback ... These reads emit `legacy_flows_db_status_fallback` diagnostic log events and must not be expanded into new chat visibility sources.
statement: In Discord/Telegram adapters, the legacy flows.db status fallback must emit legacy_flows_db_status_fallback log events and must not be used as a new chat visibility source.

quote: transport/vendor-specific logic (Codex subprocesses, app-server/OpenCode runtime, Telegram, etc.) lives in adapters/surfaces; the Engine consumes a protocol-neutral backend interface.
statement: In the engine (core/), code must not contain transport/vendor-specific logic (Codex subprocesses, app-server/OpenCode runtime, Telegram); it consumes a protocol-neutral backend interface.

quote: Root cause issues systematically; do not apply bandaid fixes or flakey fallback logic. Fix the source, not the symptom.
statement: In all code, fixes must address root causes and must not add bandaid or flaky fallback logic.

quote: Never mix repo data with worktree data; repo views must not include or mutate worktree state.
statement: In repo views and projections, code must not include or mutate worktree state.

quote: Prefer clean removal of dormant abstractions over keeping unused skeletons; if no production code uses it, delete it.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, abstractions not used by production code should be deleted rather than kept as skeletons.

quote: No backwards-compat shims or legacy fallback paths; do clean migrations only, error or warn on old shapes.
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, code must not add backwards-compat shims or legacy fallback paths; old shapes must raise an error or warn.

quote: Backend is the source of truth for state; UI should be a thin display layer, not invent significant state independently.
statement: In the web frontend, UI code should not invent significant state independently of the backend.

quote: Standardize shared components; prefer one canonical source of truth over multiple divergent implementations of the same behavior.
statement: In UI components, the same behavior should have one canonical shared component rather than divergent implementations.

quote: Surfaces and adapters must acquire subprocess-owning resources from a shared `RuntimeServices` instance.
statement: In surfaces and adapters, subprocess-owning resources (OpenCodeSupervisor, WorkspaceAppServerSupervisor/CodexAppServerClient, AgentPool) must be acquired from a shared RuntimeServices instance.

quote: Do not create long-lived subprocess supervisors ad hoc in request handlers.
statement: In request handlers, code must not construct long-lived subprocess supervisors ad hoc.

quote: Surface routing keys such as Discord channels, Telegram chats, web tabs, PMA threads, Codex threads, OpenCode sessions, and ticket ids must not key process ownership.
statement: In process-management code, process ownership must not be keyed by surface routing keys (Discord channels, Telegram chats, web tabs, PMA threads, Codex threads, OpenCode sessions, ticket ids).

quote: Every surface startup path that creates `RuntimeServices` must call `await runtime_services.close()` in its shutdown path.
statement: In surface startup code, any path that creates RuntimeServices must call `await runtime_services.close()` on shutdown.

quote: Do not expose the raw `server.auth_token_env` value to browser JavaScript
statement: In the web surface, code must not expose the raw server.auth_token_env token value to browser JavaScript.

quote: Treat `/preview/p/<token>/...` paths as secrets: do not log raw capability paths, do not include them in structured events except when returning
statement: In the web surface, raw /preview/p/<token>/ capability paths must not be logged or included in structured events.

quote: Single shared module for capture + transcription that both web and TUI call into (no bespoke per-surface logic).
statement: In voice features, web and TUI must call a single shared capture/transcription module rather than per-surface logic.

quote: Raw audio stays in-memory; no filesystem persistence unless an explicit debug flag is set (future).
statement: In voice code, raw audio must not be persisted to the filesystem.

quote: Logs redact audio and headers; only record event timings, chunk counts, and provider choice.
statement: In voice code, logs must not contain audio data or request headers; only timings, chunk counts and provider choice.

quote: The following modules must not call those raw primitives after cutover: - `src/codex_autorunner/adapters/discord/service.py` - `src/codex_autorunner/adapters/discord/interaction_dispatch.py` - `src/codex_autorunner/adapters/discord/car_command_dispatch.py`
statement: In adapters/discord/service.py, interaction_dispatch.py, car_command_dispatch.py and car_handlers/**, code must not call create_interaction_response(), create_followup_message() or edit_original_interaction_response() directly; only rest.py and the runtime responder may.

quote: business handlers and command modules must go through `src/codex_autorunner/adapters/discord/interaction_runtime.py` for defer-state checks and runtime defer/followup transitions
statement: In Discord business handlers and command modules, defer-state checks and defer/followup transitions must go through adapters/discord/interaction_runtime.py, not low-level _defer_*, _send_followup_* or _interaction_has_initial_response() helpers.

quote: `ingress.py` becomes payload parsing, authz evaluation, and route-key extraction only. It returns a normalized envelope and never calls Discord.
statement: In adapters/discord/ingress.py, code must only parse payloads, evaluate authz and extract route keys, and must never call the Discord API.

quote: Legacy broad-fetch endpoints may remain for diagnostics and tests, but screen routes must not use them as primary data sources.
statement: In web UI screen routes, legacy broad-fetch endpoints must not be used as primary data sources.

quote: Route handlers own screen-shaped payload composition and repair responses; they must not push graph reconstruction into Svelte page components.
statement: In web read-model routes, screen-shaped payload composition must be done server-side; Svelte page components must not perform graph reconstruction.

quote: Cursors are ordered within a `source`; clients must not compare sequence values across unrelated sources. Cursor values are opaque strings for clients.
statement: In web frontend read-model clients, cursors must be treated as opaque strings and must not be compared across sources.

quote: Clients must not infer durable ordering from timestamps. Ordering comes from the snapshot window and subsequent `reorder` or `reset` events.
statement: In web frontend read-model clients, list ordering must not be derived from timestamps; it comes from snapshot windows and reorder/reset events.

quote: Temporary compatibility behavior must be labeled in code comments or durable docs with its non-UI purpose and removal condition.
statement: In web read-model code, temporary compatibility behavior must carry a code comment (or doc) stating its purpose and removal condition.

quote: **Hover earns affordance.** Borders strengthen, shadows lift gently, hidden chevrons slide in. Never animate layout-shifting properties.
statement: In web frontend CSS, transitions/animations must not animate layout-shifting properties (e.g. width, height, margin).

quote: **Always use the tokens. Never hardcode colors, radii, shadows, or spacing in component styles.**
statement: In web frontend component styles, colors, radii, shadows and spacing must use design tokens from src/app.css (var(--...)) and must not be hardcoded.

quote: `src/lib/test/designTokens.test.ts` fails the build on any `var(--token)` written without a fallback whose token is not declared. If you need a new token, add it to `:root` (and to every theme block that overrides its family) rather than adding a fallback.
statement: In web frontend styles, every var(--token) must reference a token declared in :root of src/app.css; new tokens must be added to :root and theme blocks rather than using a fallback.

quote: 16px max — only the composer and modals. Never higher.
statement: In web frontend styles, border-radius must not exceed 16px, and 16px is only for the composer and modals.

quote: `--shadow-card-hover`: the hover lift for cards. Don't invent new shadow values; use this token.
statement: In web frontend styles, card hover shadows must use the --shadow-card-hover token; new shadow values must not be invented.

quote: The opt-in list lives in one block near the top of `app.css`. Add your class there rather than writing `font-family` in a component. **Never re-declare a mono stack inline** (`ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, …`) — use the token.
statement: In Svelte components, code must not set font-family directly or re-declare a monospace stack; mono text opts in via the class list in app.css using --font-mono.

quote: Set prose in the mono face. Nav labels, button labels, page titles, message bodies, and help text are language, not machine text — see Typography.
statement: In web frontend styles, prose (nav labels, button labels, page titles, message bodies, help text) must not be set in --font-mono; mono is only for ids, paths, branches, code.

quote: Weights: 500 for muted, 550–620 for body bold and headings, 650 for numerics. Never go above 700.
statement: In web frontend styles, font-weight must never exceed 700.

quote: Tabular numerics: always `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on counts, KPIs, and timestamps.
statement: In web frontend styles, counts, KPIs and timestamps must use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

quote: All easing should reference `--ease-out`. Never write custom cubics.
statement: In web frontend styles, transition easing must use var(--ease-out) and must not use custom cubic-bezier() values.

quote: `.page-stack` is capped at `--measure-page` (1120px) and centred. **Never remove that cap to "use the space".**
statement: In page styles, the .page-stack max-width cap (--measure-page) must not be removed or overridden (chat .master-detail/.pma-layout excepted).

quote:
Use the shared `PageHero` component for the title + subtitle + optional right-aligned KPI strip. **Don't reach for a hand-rolled `.section-heading` with `

`.**
statement:
In full-page routes, the page header must use the shared PageHero component, not a hand-rolled .section-heading or

.

quote: **No background fill, no border on the hero itself.** The header is bare type on the page background.
statement: In page hero headers, styles must not add a background fill or border to the hero.

quote: **Never tint the zero state** — a green "0" reads as success when it's really "nothing to celebrate yet."
statement: In hero KPI stats, zero values must not be tinted with a semantic color.

quote: The whole card is the link (`<a class="repo-card" href=…>`). Avoid nested anchors. If you need secondary actions, put them as separate buttons underneath, not inside the link.
statement: In card components, the whole card must be the <a> link and must not contain nested anchors or action buttons inside the link.

quote: Initials are 1–2 uppercase letters extracted from the label (`repoInitials()` in `src/lib/viewModels/repoIdentity.ts`). - Accent color hashes deterministically from the label using a fixed 8-color palette (`repoAccent()`, same module). Reuse these helpers; don't invent new colors per entity type.
statement: In avatar rendering, initials and accent colors must come from repoInitials() and repoAccent() in src/lib/viewModels/repoIdentity.ts, not new per-entity colors.

quote: Don't render a count chip for zero unless it's contextually needed.
statement: In Svelte components, .count-chip should not be rendered when the count is zero.

quote: Plural the noun based on the count (`run` vs `runs`).
statement: In count chips and labels, the noun must be pluralized based on the count (never "1 runs").

quote: **A row must always carry one stable, scannable identifier in addition to its name** so that a user can refer to "the third one" or correlate with logs.
statement: In list rows for chats, runs, tickets, drafts and scratch repos, each row must render a short id chip (.chat-id-tag/.id-tag, 6 mono chars of the stable id) in the meta row, not the title.

quote: Never use color alone for state. Always pair with a label or icon.
statement: In UI components, state indicators must not rely on color alone; they must be paired with a text label or icon.

quote: Use those literal tokens in view-model status fields and CSS status modifiers. Reserve `active` for UI buckets such as selected filters or aggregate counts, not as a status synonym for `running`.
statement: In view-model status fields and CSS status modifiers, statuses must use the literal tokens running/waiting/blocked/failed/done/idle, and `active` must not be used as a synonym for `running`.

quote: Never invent intermediate sizes; if the scale doesn't fit, you're using the wrong mechanism.
statement: In status dot styles, dots must use the 6px .status-dot.status-<status> scale and must not use other sizes.

quote: **Never use `--color-accent` (brand purple) for the fill.**
statement: In progress indicators (.progress-track), the fill must not use --color-accent; it comes from a status-<status> modifier.

quote: Use the brand accent for non-action affordances. Accent means "click me," "active selection," or "you wrote this" (the user's own chat turn).
statement: In web frontend styles, --color-accent must not be used for non-action affordances (progress bars, status indicators, live badges).

quote: Pair the bar with a textual percent or step label nearby. The bar alone is not enough
statement: In progress indicators, a progress bar must be accompanied by a textual percent or step label.

quote: Always `aria-label`. **No emoji-only buttons.** Emoji is decoration, not a glyph — use the SVG icon set or render a labeled ghost button.
statement: In Svelte components, icon buttons (.icon-button, .icon-action) must have an aria-label, and buttons must not have emoji-only content.

quote: **Badges are read-only.** If a badge needs to be clickable, it's not a badge — promote it to a ghost button.
statement: In Svelte components, badges (.status-pill, .count-chip, .id-tag, .kind-chip) must not be clickable; clickable elements must be ghost buttons.

quote: **Never render a badge that looks like a button.** No borders on status pills, no `cursor: pointer` on count chips that don't actually navigate.
statement: In web frontend styles, status pills must not have borders and non-navigating count chips must not have cursor: pointer.

quote: **Never style two distinct actions identically.** If a row has both "Clear state" and "Retire worktree", they get distinct labels (not two "Retire" buttons differentiated only by emoji), and the destructive one gets the `.danger` variant.
statement: In Svelte components, distinct actions in a row must have distinct labels, and destructive actions must use the .ghost-button.danger variant.

quote: A right-aligned text link styled as `Browse all →` next to a section H2 reads as a sibling label, not an action — the user can't tell which is clickable. Don't ship them.
statement: In section headers, actions must be rendered as <a class="ghost-button"> inside header.section-header, not as bare `Browse all →` text links.

quote: Render as `.ghost-button` by default. Disabled, label reads "Saved" or similar terminal verb.
statement: In settings/preferences forms, the save button should be a disabled .ghost-button at rest that gains a .dirty modifier when the form differs from the saved snapshot, not a permanent primary CTA.

quote: while the content is shorter than the viewport (`:not(.can-scroll)`) the viewport lays out as a column with `justify-content: flex-end`. Do not remove that rule;
statement: In the chat transcript styles, the `:not(.can-scroll)` justify-content: flex-end rule must not be removed.

quote: All three render via `.state-panel` (already styled in `app.css`).
statement: In Svelte components, empty, loading and error states must render via .state-panel (with compact-empty/empty-state, loading-state, or error modifiers).

quote: Partial-page degradations: render the `degradedIssues` snippet per-section. Don't fail the whole page when only one slice failed.
statement: In page components, partial failures should be rendered per section via the degradedIssues snippet rather than failing the whole page.

quote: Never render a disabled `<select>` with explanatory hint text; a disabled control invites a click that has no good outcome.
statement: In Svelte components, locked values must render as read-only text, not as a disabled <select>.

quote: Selectable detail views must be **path-addressable**, not query-string addressable.
statement: In SvelteKit routes, selectable detail views must be addressed by path segments (e.g. /chats/[[chatId]]) rather than query-string parameters.

quote: One file per master-detail page using SvelteKit optional params (`/chats/[[chatId]]/+page.svelte`). The same component handles both list and detail; it reads `page.params.<id>` to decide which mode to render.
statement: In SvelteKit routes, master-detail pages should use one +page.svelte with an optional param ([[id]]) reading page.params, and row selection should navigate via goto.

quote: Add a structured route in `breadcrumbs.ts` for any new path-based detail view. Keep most-specific patterns first.
statement: In the web frontend, every new path-based detail view must have a structured route in breadcrumbs.ts, ordered most-specific first.

quote: The breadcrumb is the **canonical back affordance**. Don't ship a separate "back to list" button when the breadcrumb already does the job.
statement: In detail views, code must not render a separate "back to list" button when the breadcrumb provides navigation.

quote: `MasterDetail.svelte` accepts `showSwitch={false}` for exactly this case. Reach for it any time you give the page proper deep links.
statement: In path-addressable master-detail pages, MasterDetail must be used with showSwitch={false}.

quote: Modals use the `.modal-backdrop` + `.approval-modal` shell.
statement: In Svelte components, modals must use the .modal-backdrop + .approval-modal shell.

quote: `aria-label` every icon-only button, every nav, every list region.
statement: In Svelte components, every icon-only button, <nav> and list region must have an aria-label.

quote: Tab order follows visual order. Don't reorder with `tabindex`.
statement: In Svelte components, positive tabindex values must not be used to reorder focus.

quote: **Heading hierarchy.** Every page has exactly one `<h1>`, supplied by `PageHero`. Section titles are `<h2>`, subheads inside a section are `<h3>`. Don't skip a level for visual reasons; restyle the level instead.
statement: In page components, each page must emit exactly one <h1> (via PageHero or a visible <h1>), section titles as <h2> and subheads as <h3>, without skipped levels or visually-hidden headings.

quote: When a feature is too new for the baseline (e.g. CSS nesting at the time of writing), add a comment in `app.css` calling out the polyfill or fallback path. Don't silently rely on it.
statement: In app.css, use of CSS features newer than the evergreen baseline must carry a comment describing the polyfill or fallback.

quote: Svelte 5 runes throughout: `$state`, `$derived`, `$props`, `$effect`. No legacy stores in new code.
statement: In Svelte components, new code must use Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $props, $effect) and must not use legacy stores (svelte/store writable/readable).

quote: Component scripts: `<script lang="ts">`. Props go through `$props()` with an inline type literal; default optional props with `= null` / `= []` in the destructure.
statement: In Svelte components, scripts must be <script lang="ts"> and props must be destructured from $props() with an inline type literal, defaulting optional props with = null / = [].

quote: Prefer scoped `<style>` blocks per component for new visual rules. Promote to `app.css` only when ≥3 components share the rule.
statement: In Svelte components, new visual rules should go in the component's scoped <style> block and only be promoted to app.css when shared by 3 or more components.

quote: Use `:global()` to pierce a child component's styles (e.g. EditableMarkdown's body inside the memory reader). Never hand-edit a child component to satisfy the parent's layout.
statement: In Svelte components, parent layout adjustments to child component styles must use :global() in the parent rather than editing the child component.

quote: Classes are kebab-case BEM-ish (`.repo-card`, `.repo-card-body`, `.repo-card-counts`). No utility soup, no Tailwind in this app.
statement: In Svelte components, CSS class names must be kebab-case BEM-ish (e.g. .repo-card-body) and Tailwind/utility classes must not be used.

quote: View models live under `src/lib/viewModels/`; components consume the shaped output. Don't reach into raw API data from components.
statement: In Svelte components, data must come from view models under src/lib/viewModels/; components must not consume raw API payloads directly.

quote: The breakpoints are `1020px`, `760px`, `460px` (already declared in `app.css`). Apply these inside component `<style>` blocks too:
statement: In component <style> blocks, media query breakpoints should be 1020px, 760px or 460px only.

quote: Stack borders inside borders (panel border + card border + inner row border). Always remove one of them.
statement: In UI layout, borders must not be stacked three deep (panel + card + inner row); long config pages use the flat .settings-section pattern.

quote: Build new layout primitives by copying CSS into a component's `<style>` block when the same shape exists in `app.css` or as a shared component. Promote the pattern, then use it.
statement: In Svelte components, layout CSS must not be copied from app.css or a shared component into a component <style> block; reuse the shared class/component.

quote: Emit standalone `·` separator elements in a meta line that can wrap. Draw them with `> * + *::before` so the separator travels with the item it precedes
statement: In wrapping meta lines, separators must be drawn with a `> * + *::before` CSS rule rather than standalone `·` elements.

quote: Show raw markdown in a preview or summary. Excerpts of a markdown body go through `markdownPreview()` (`$lib/viewModels/plainText`)
statement: In previews and summaries, markdown excerpts must be passed through markdownPreview() from $lib/viewModels/plainText rather than shown raw.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint] select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B"] -- "E"
statement: In all Python files, pycodestyle error rules (ruff E) must pass.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint] select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B"] -- "F"
statement: In all Python files, Pyflakes rules (ruff F: unused imports/variables, undefined names) must pass.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint] select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B"] -- "W"
statement: In all Python files, pycodestyle warning rules (ruff W) must pass.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint] select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B"] -- "I"
statement: In all Python files, imports must be sorted per isort rules (ruff I) with src = ["src"] as first-party.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint] select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B"] -- "B"
statement: In all Python files, flake8-bugbear rules (ruff B, e.g. mutable defaults, function calls in defaults) must pass.

quote: ignore = ["E501"]
statement: In all Python files, line-too-long (E501) is not enforced by ruff.

quote: [tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores] "src/codex_autorunner/cli.py" = ["B008"] ... "src/codex_autorunner/surfaces/cli/commands/*.py" = ["B008"] ... "src/codex_autorunner/surfaces/web/routes/terminal_images.py" = ["B008"] "src/codex_autorunner/surfaces/web/routes/voice.py" = ["B008"]
statement: In Typer CLI modules (cli.py, surfaces/cli/*.py, surfaces/cli/commands/*.py) and web routes terminal_images.py and voice.py, B008 (function calls in argument defaults, e.g. typer.Option/File) is allowed.

quote: "src/codex_autorunner/adapters/telegram/adapter.py" = ["F401"]
statement: In adapters/telegram/adapter.py, unused imports (F401, re-exports) are allowed.

quote: "tests/adapters/chat/test_parity_checker.py" = ["E402"] ... "tests/tickets/test_ticket_runner.py" = ["E402"]
statement: In the listed test modules (tests/adapters/chat/test_parity_checker.py, tests/adapters/discord/test_*.py, tests/test_hub_*.py, tests/tickets/test_ticket_runner.py, etc.), module-level imports not at top of file (E402) are allowed.

quote: [tool.mypy] warn_return_any = true
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, functions must not return Any from functions declared to return a specific type.

quote: no_implicit_optional = true
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, parameters defaulting to None must be explicitly typed Optional[...] / `X | None`.

quote: ignore_missing_imports = true
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, mypy does not report missing stubs/imports for third-party modules.

quote: warn_unused_ignores = true
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, `# type: ignore` comments must not be unused.

quote: check_untyped_defs = true
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, bodies of unannotated functions are type-checked and must pass mypy.

quote: [[tool.mypy.overrides]] module = ["codex_autorunner.core", "codex_autorunner.core.*"] ignore_errors = false ... module = ["codex_autorunner.adapters.app_server", "codex_autorunner.adapters.app_server.*"] ignore_errors = false
statement: In codex_autorunner.core.* and codex_autorunner.adapters.app_server.*, mypy errors must not be ignored.

quote: "void-style": "off"
statement: In HTML files, html-validate's void-style rule (self-closing vs not for void elements) is not enforced.

quote: "element-permitted-content": "off"
statement: In HTML files, html-validate's element-permitted-content rule is not enforced.

quote: "strict": true
statement: In web frontend TypeScript, code must type-check under TypeScript strict mode (no implicit any, strict null checks).

quote: "verbatimModuleSyntax": true
statement: In web frontend TypeScript, type-only imports must use `import type` (verbatimModuleSyntax).

quote: "allowJs": false, "checkJs": false
statement: In the web frontend, source modules must be TypeScript; JavaScript files are not compiled.

quote: "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true
statement: In web frontend TypeScript, import paths must match file name casing exactly.

quote: "core": {"deny": ("codex_autorunner.adapters", "codex_autorunner.surfaces", "codex_autorunner.cli", "codex_autorunner.server")}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/core/**, code must not import (statically or via literal importlib.import_module/__import__) codex_autorunner.adapters, codex_autorunner.surfaces, codex_autorunner.cli or codex_autorunner.server.

quote: "adapters": {"deny": ("codex_autorunner.surfaces", "codex_autorunner.cli", "codex_autorunner.server")}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/adapters/**, code must not import (statically or via literal dynamic import) codex_autorunner.surfaces, codex_autorunner.cli or codex_autorunner.server.

quote: if module.startswith("codex_autorunner.adapters.agents"): allowed_interfaces = {"agent_backend", "run_event"} ... allowed_interface_symbols = {"AgentBackend", "AgentEvent", "AgentEventType", "RunEvent", ...}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/core/**, runtime imports from codex_autorunner.adapters.agents must be limited to the agent_backend and run_event modules or interface symbols (AgentBackend, AgentEvent, AgentEventType, RunEvent, Started, OutputDelta, ToolCall, ApprovalRequested, Completed, Failed, get_registered_agents); TYPE_CHECKING imports are exempt.

quote: if module.startswith("codex_autorunner.adapters.app_server"): return True, "forbidden import from adapters/app_server (implementation)"
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/core/**, code must not import codex_autorunner.adapters.app_server at runtime (outside TYPE_CHECKING).

quote: if module.startswith("codex_autorunner.agents"): return True, "forbidden import from agents (implementation)"
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/core/**, code must not import codex_autorunner.agents implementations at runtime (outside TYPE_CHECKING).

quote: BANNED_CALLS: dict[str, str] = { "rotate_corrupt_flow_db": "", ...}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/surfaces/**, code must not call rotate_corrupt_flow_db(); use flows.controller_provider.recover_flow_store(db_path, exc).

quote: "FlowController": "web",
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/surfaces/web/**, code must not call FlowController(...); resolve via flows.controller_provider.FlowControllerProvider (flow_routes.definitions.controller_provider_for(state)).

quote: Guard against non-hermetic writable /tmp usage in tests. ... 1) Direct write-style operations against absolute /tmp paths. 2) Root-path keyword arguments in tests that point to /tmp and may become writable shared roots over time.
statement: In tests/**, code must not perform write operations (mkdir, write_text, touch, unlink, rename, tempfile dir=) against absolute /tmp paths or pass /tmp to root keyword args (workspace_root, repo_root, run_dir, etc.).

quote: Flag hardcoded colors in the Web Hub frontend. ... Every other component must consume those tokens via ``var(--color-*)`` / ``var(--shadow-*)`` so themes stay swappable. ... Lines tagged with ``/* theme-allow */`` are skipped
statement: In web frontend *.css and *.svelte <style> blocks (outside :root/[data-theme] token blocks and theme-presets.css), color literals (#hex, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla()) must not be used unless the line is tagged /* theme-allow */.

quote: "is_within": {"module": "codex_autorunner.core.utils", "description": "Path containment check (root, target)"}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, calls to codex_autorunner.core.utils.is_within must pass arguments by keyword, not positionally.

quote: "_is_within": {"module": "codex_autorunner.core.archive", "description": "Path containment check (root, target)"}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, calls to codex_autorunner.core.archive._is_within must pass arguments by keyword, not positionally.

quote: "_path_within": {"module": "codex_autorunner.adapters.discord.service", "description": "Path containment check (root, target)"}
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, calls to codex_autorunner.adapters.discord.service._path_within must pass arguments by keyword, not positionally.

quote: HINT_CONSTANTS = {"PROMPT_CONTEXT_HINT", "WHISPER_TRANSCRIPT_DISCLAIMER", "FILES_HINT_TEMPLATE"} ... f"{node.id} must be passed through a capsule or transport renderer."
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/**, PROMPT_CONTEXT_HINT, WHISPER_TRANSCRIPT_DISCLAIMER and FILES_HINT_TEMPLATE must only be referenced inside calls to capsule/transport renderers (build_*_capsule, render_legacy_injected_context_transport), in their definition, or in `in` comparisons.

quote: ALLOWED_SHUTIL_WHICH = {SRC_ROOT / "core" / "utils.py", SRC_ROOT / "core" / "update.py"} ... "shutil.which usage is restricted; use resolve_executable instead."
statement: In src/codex_autorunner/** (except core/utils.py and core/update.py), code must not call shutil.which directly; use codex_autorunner.core.utils.resolve_executable.

quote: Compare svelte-check warnings against the committed warning baseline. ... "Fail when svelte-check emits warnings outside the baseline."
statement: In web frontend Svelte files, code must not introduce new svelte-check warnings beyond scripts/svelte_warning_baseline.json.

quote: Heuristic dead-code scanner for this repo (stdlib-only). ... Python: scans module-level defs/classes in src/, counts NAME-token references across src/. Skips decorated defs/classes
statement: In src/**, new module-level functions/classes must not be unreferenced (dead code) beyond the .deadcode-baseline.json baseline.

quote: PROTECTED_PREFIX = ".codex-autorunner" ALLOWED_PATHS = {".codex-autorunner/.gitignore"}
statement: In the repo, files under .codex-autorunner/ (other than .codex-autorunner/.gitignore) must not be committed.
